title: FX DMA Tool Overview
buildon_idea: Admin/tooling video only; no EA mechanism to extract
novelty_note: Tool tutorial for FX DMA builder platform

title: EMA Alignment + William %R Mean Reversion
entry_long: EMA9>EMA200 and EMA9 crosses above EMA26; William %R > -80 (overbought signal to enter on reversal); minimum candle body size 20 pips
entry_short: EMA9<EMA200 and EMA9 crosses below EMA26; William %R < -20 (oversold signal); minimum candle body size 20 pips
exit: trailing stop or market price close within Fair Value Gap
escalation_cap: scale up on rebalance; no explicit cap
buildon_idea: Add SL window; test flat-lot first before escalation; consider exit on opposite signal rather than trailing; scale max steps to 3-5 with SL
novelty_note: Simple EMA alignment + WSR, profitable for mean-reversion setups; 5-year backtest shows ~95% gain/year but high DD

title: Rebalance Grid (Martingale with Dual Groups)
entry_long: open buy group 1; if price reverses down, open sell group 2 at rebalance distance (30 pips); if price goes back up, add to buy
entry_short: open sell group 1; if price reverses up, open buy group 2 at rebalance distance; if price goes back down, add to sell
exit: close both groups when combined profit >= 3 USD
escalation_cap: 2 groups of orders, spaced 30 pips, capped at grid distance
buildon_idea: Cap escalation steps (user demonstrated 1,600 orders in 3 days on 1m TF); add initial SL; reduce target profit for higher frequency; test with 2 groups max before expanding; requires tight money-management cage
novelty_note: Dual-group rebalance that profits on reversals; generates many trades in sideways; low per-trade profit but high volume

title: Fair Value Gap (ICT Price Action)
indicators: Price pattern: 3-candle FVG (body gap between candles 1 and 3)
entry_long: when price fills a bullish FVG (close between lower fvg band and upper fvg band after reversing up) and candle body >= 20 pips
entry_short: when price fills a bearish FVG (close between upper fvg band and lower fvg band after reversing down) and candle body >= 20 pips
buildon_idea: Add SL at FVG extreme; add TP target (e.g. 100 pips); combine with other PA patterns (support/resistance) to filter entries; test on multiple TF simultaneously
novelty_note: ICT-based FVG strategy; clean price-action driven; low trade frequency; 2-year backtest ~78% return, max DD 3.75%

title: Dynamic Grid Zone with Hedge Strategy
symbol: XAUUSD (tested, works on FX pairs too)
entry_long: open buy when in zone; if price reverses, enter sell group to hedge; close when combined profit >= 5 USD or after TP reached
entry_short: open sell when in zone; if price reverses, enter buy group to hedge; rebalance groups as price moves
exit: close all groups at profit target or % balance loss (default -10%)
escalation_cap: frame-based zone; zone width 2,000 pips typical; hedge group triggered on reversal
buildon_idea: Cap grid steps (e.g. 20 max buy/sell per group); add hard SL outside zone; monitor consecutive losses and add daily/weekly reset; backtest shows 264 trades/month on standard spread
novelty_note: Automated dynamic zone capture; works on both trending and sideways; hedging absorbs loss side; good for low-spread environments (micro accounts)

title: Multi-TF Multi-Indicator Dashboard EA
entry_long: when EMA alignment bullish + RSI > 60 on majority of timeframes; open 0.5 lot buy
entry_short: when EMA alignment bearish + RSI < 30 on majority of timeframes; open 0.5 lot sell
exit: SL=100 pips, TP=100 pips, or market close
buildon_idea: Add position-size input via dashboard; separate SL/TP fields; add money-loss cap (USD limit); extend to 20+ pairs; add correlation-based lot-scaling (high-corr pairs reduce individual lot)
novelty_note: Educational EA demonstrating dashboard UI + multi-TF logic; shows symbol array pattern and Edit Field creation; clear visual signal matching across timeframes

title: Dashboard EA for Go Space Account (Simplified 10-Pair)
exit: SL=15 pips, TP=15 pips (tight, suitable for 1m scalp)
buildon_idea: Add money-loss gate (e.g. 4 USD max daily loss); allow user-defined SL/TP via input fields; add profit-taking rule (close at daily +50 pips or -40 pips); backtest with wider SL/TP (30-50 pips) to reduce whipsaws
novelty_note: Practical dashboard covering 10 FX pairs simultaneously; designed for Go Space micro accounts; 5-second update rate matches broker feed latency; shows array-based UI pattern

title: EA Development Framework: 4 Dimensions
buildon_idea: This is a meta-discussion of 4 dimensions for robust EA design: (1) strategy clarity (simple, no overfit), (2) risk management (position sizing, max loss, QSwitch on drawdown, capped escalation), (3) code quality (spread check, digit support, error handling, magic numbers, event logging), (4) long-term testing (backtest quality, in-sample/out-of-sample split, forward test, live stats monitoring). Use this as a gate before accepting any DEPLOY candidate.
novelty_note: Educational framework; distills real-world EA failure modes; emphasizes that short-term PF is not deployment criteria; stability over raw returns is key theme
